title: Warehouse Rate Card: Weekly Storage Rate by Installation Job Size — Factory Production Orders
content:
**Rate card.** For Factory Production Orders, the weekly storage rate per unit follows the units the installation job installs:

| Units the installation job installs | Weekly storage rate per unit |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 85 percent of the class storage fee per unit per week |
| 7 to 11 | the class storage fee per unit per week |
| 6 or fewer | 125 percent (1.25 times) of the class storage fee per unit per week |

The unit figure is the one on the Installation Jobs record of the order's installation job — the openings or door units it installs.

## Rates by class (USD per unit per week, before the fee is rounded to the cent)

| Build class | Class fee | 12 or more units | 7 to 11 units | 6 or fewer units |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Custom Size Build | 6.00 | 5.10 | 6.00 | 7.50 |
| Custom Color Build | 6.00 | 5.10 | 6.00 | 7.50 |
| Specialty Glass Build | 7.50 | 6.375 | 7.50 | 9.375 |
| Specialty Shape Build | 7.50 | 6.375 | 7.50 | 9.375 |
| Impact-Rated Build | 9.00 | 7.65 | 9.00 | 11.25 |
| Architectural Wood Build | 12.00 | 10.20 | 12.00 | 15.00 |

## Edges

- 12 units: 85 percent; 11 units: the class fee.
- 7 units: the class fee; 6 units: 125 percent.
